controlled_assignment.concept: Low-noise receiver calibration at a polar radio observatory

prompt.prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary portrait of an adult polar radio-observatory maintenance engineer at an ice-rimed steerable dish during cobalt polar twilight. She calibrates a frost-coated low-noise receiver module with a handheld spectrum analyzer beside an open waveguide cabinet; tagged fiber lines, instrument readouts, snow fencing, and distant antenna structures establish the operational setting. Frame her chest-up in a restrained three-quarter view while her hands and analyzer remain legible. Hair is swept behind both ears, clear of the temples, cheek edges, jaw corners, and chin; the complete bilateral face perimeter remains unobscured. Give her a round compact face contour and a compact near-equal width-to-length silhouette: her facial length stays close to width, the cheek-to-cheek region carries broad width, and a soft curved jaw ends in a short rounded chin. A neutral expression and controlled perspective preserve the global contour. Use a distortion-controlled portrait lens and soft frontal shape light with cold ambient reflection from the snow. Realize the adult subject directly from this photographic specification.

schema_audit_separation.reason: The pack has strict visual_obligations but no enabled moe_response or render_qualification contract. The actual five-gate pixel judgment is recorded independently in pixel_review.json.

independence_proof.recorder_manifest_limitation: record_image_run.py treats an empty reference_sha256 list as a missing manifest prerequisite; the recorder-validated ledger was retained and the protocol-required empty-list v2 manifest was materialized arm-locally.

overall_technical_judgment.basis: The no-image-input runtime audit passed and all five exact round_compact_face_relation gates passed on the same saved image at their required scales.
